verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API v2 can read, list, and search feedback, documents, customers, and product hierarchy entities with cursor-based pagination on every list endpoint, so a user could script a full extraction. However, the evidence shows no first-party export or offboarding feature, and nothing confirms the API covers all workspace data. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-workspace export (e.g. CSV/JSON download), an explicit statement of open export formats, proof the API covers every data type including attachments and comments, and independent corroboration of a clean exit.
